title: Add FolderSetupView full-screen onboarding
description: Create CookbookApp/FolderSetupView.swift. A centered full-screen view rendered by AppRoot when no folder is configured. Contains: folder.badge.questionmark SF Symbol at large size; title Please select a folder with recipes (.title2); subtitle explanation (.body, .secondary); primary Button(Choose folder…) styled .borderedProminent that presents RecipesFolderPicker. On successful pick, persists the bookmark via RecipesFolderStore, triggering AppRoot to transition to the tab-bar shell. Accessibility label set on the button.
acceptance_criteria: Displays folder.badge.questionmark, title, and subtitle as specified.
Choose folder… button is .borderedProminent and triggers RecipesFolderPicker.
On successful pick, bookmark is persisted via RecipesFolderStore.
No tab bar is visible (AppRoot responsibility, but FolderSetupView must not embed one).
Accessibility label is set on the Choose folder… button.
